title: Contrast presets for dense data grids and chart axes in dark console themes
creator: Priya Patel
description: Introduce a small set of deterministic contrast presets and token overrides targeted at dense data grids (tables with >80 columns/rows density) and chart axes/legends under dark/brand variants. Goal is to improve readability and interaction clarity without increasing perceived visual noise or breaking brand color usage. This ticket covers token mappings, component overrides for Table, DataGrid, Sparkline, and Axis/Legend components, and a short A/B spec for metrics dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 3 contrast presets (Low, Medium, High) mapped to existing token families and documented with token names and numeric color values.
Table row/column separators maintain 3:1 contrast against surface in Low preset, 4.5:1 in High preset for accessibility-critical customers.
Chart axis labels and gridlines adopt a default that preserves label legibility at 12px in High-DPI and low-luminance brand variants.
No visual regressions on existing light themes; unit visual diffs in Storybook show explicit changes limited to dark/brand variants.
Design tokens and override mappings included in theme tokens file and referenced in release notes for console-2026.04.
Engineering integration plan and ENG owners assigned; PR merged and e2e smoke test for main dashboard validates text legibility thresholds.
notes_updates: 2026-03-10 - Ticket created by Priya: initial research shows axis labels drop below WCAG 2.1 AA at 12px in several brand-dark variants. Proposal: three presets to give customers deterministic levers.
2026-03-11 - UX research: ran quick readabilty test with 8 participants on nightly build; Medium preset preferred in 6/8 cases for balance between contrast and visual weight.
2026-03-12 - Design: assembled token map (surface/ink/muted) and proposed numeric deltas for separator and axis tokens. Uploaded figma frames and sketch-based token table.
2026-03-12 - Engineering sync: alignment with ENG-20412 for DataGrid coherent row/column separator prop. ENG utc owners: Marco Rivera and Linh Tran.
2026-03-13 - Accessibility review: flagged that High preset should be opt-in for brand-themed consoles where contrast impacts brand hue; security_review_required not needed.
2026-03-14 - Prototype: Storybook story created showing table density toggles across Low/Medium/High presets; visual diff baseline created. PR reference added to engineering_links.
review_feedback: From Design Lead (Marcos Alvarez) on 2026-03-12: prefer token names to be explicit (eg token.table.separator.strong) rather than numeric deltas so downstream teams can consume them programmatically.
From Accessibility (Nina Gupta) on 2026-03-13: ensure axis gridlines are still identifiable by colourblind users; recommend adding 10% increase in line weight when High preset is enabled for charts.
From PM (Ravi Shah) on 2026-03-14: surface the preset choice in Console Appearance settings and add a short blurb explaining tradeoffs; track adoption metrics.
decisions: Adopt explicit token names for presets: token.presets.contrast.low|medium|high -> maps to component tokens at build time.
Limit automatic application to dark and brand-variant themes; light theme remains unaffected.
Chart axes will receive combined treatment: color token + optional 10% stroke weight increase controlled by chart config flag.

notes_for_engineers: Token export format must expose preset bindings as plain token names, not runtime deltas.
Use existing token namespace convention token.component-name.property.preset to avoid coupling.
Include a minimal perf benchmark for table rendering with High preset (thicker separators) to ensure no meaningful regression for very large tables.
